name: Sara
source:
Became part of the protagonist's class a few weeks prior to him moving.

[spoiler]Is actually an alien. Was sent to Earth to kill Saori. According to Saori, her home planet was destroyed, but Sara doesn't know that. Regardless of the ending, Sara is killed by Saori.[/spoiler]
